items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Bobby penned it but ... my solo, the trumpet solo and stuff that I did on it.

ctx.x: And that's how that came out. But I just, Bobby penned it but (inaudible) my solo, the trumpet solo and stuff that I did on
it. I just kept in and I just kept changing it practically every night till I just figured out what I want. When I got there, I just stayed on that one cause he left those openings in there for me.
